## Editorial review

- [ ] The article facts are supported by the original source.
- [ ] Analysis is clearly separated from reported facts and gives a concrete implication, action, or limitation specific to this story.
- [ ] Primary documents are linked in `references` when available; each link was opened and supports the claim.
- [ ] `reviewedBy` and `reviewedAt` are set only after an actual editorial review; otherwise `reviewedBy` remains null.
- [ ] Thai copy is concise, natural, and not clickbait.
- [ ] Source links are original sources and do not contain tracking parameters.
- [ ] Categories and tags are relevant and limited in scope.
- [ ] No prompt text, JSON fragments, placeholders, or fake citations are present.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm validate:content`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
